title: Theater of Forgotten Dreams
description: A woman with dark curly hair and golden halo sits pensively in a red velvet theater seat, holding a teacup as ethereal smoke rises. Behind her, a massive cinematic screen displays a lone silhouetted figure walking through a flooded, columned hall toward a distant glowing doorway under a stormy sky.
